minor.issue: Old rokad documents created before v1.3 do not expose voucher_no/chq_no keys in response (Pydantic defaults not applied because response uses raw mongo dict not Rokad model). Test had to filter to imported rows only. Recommend either (a) running a one-time migration to backfill these fields, or (b) project them with $ifNull / use the Pydantic model on response.
Returns '1' for any unknown pid (no 404). Minor - matches FoxPro behavior of starting fresh, but could be surprising for typos.
Carry-over from v1.2: _next_bill_no still uses count_documents (not race-safe).

issues: Version label still reads 'HISAB KITAB V1.1' even though backend/import features are v1.3. Update to V1.3 for clarity (cosmetic only).

Imported P00001-P00004 BAKI column shows full bill total as outstanding (payment_received=0). Expected for freshly imported FoxPro bills but the bright red rendering may confuse user. Consider muting BAKI color when bill is from historical import or showing 'imported' tag.
Carry-over dev-only React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from Emergent x-source instrumentation.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1470 lines (was 1005 in v1.2). Strongly recommend splitting into routers/ subpackage: auth, parties, items, bills, rokad, inward, accounts, journal, reports, backup, settings, import_dbf, gst_returns. Single-file growth is making future merges risky.

The 6 DBF import endpoints (ledger/cashbook/inward/items/gst/transactions) share a lot of boilerplate (party_by_code map, date isoformat, error counters, bulk insert). Extract a common helper or use a strategy/dispatch by table name.
/api/import-dbf/gst does delete_many({}) before insert - destructive. Consider an 'upsert by primary key' mode and/or a confirmation flag to prevent accidental data loss when re-running import.
/api/cash-accounts/{pid}/next-voucher scans up to 10000 rokad rows per call and parses voucher_no in Python. For larger scale, switch to Mongo aggregation $max with $toInt conversion.

Imported P0000x bills carry payment_received=0 so BAKI equals full total, which sums to ~₹44.5L outstanding in current import. Verify this matches business reality before showing on dashboard KPIs (otherwise opening balances should be netted against bill totals).
GST returns endpoint does not paginate (.to_list(5000)) - fine for 50 rows today, plan for pagination when multi-year data is imported.
